text.inFlightRequestsIfTheyRiseWithTheQueueWa: In-flight requests. If they rise with the queue, watch service capacity.
text.waitQueueLengthPersistentlyNonZeroMeansR: Wait-queue length. Persistently non-zero means requests are backing up.
text.higherPrefixCacheHitRateUsuallyMeansLowe: Higher prefix-cache hit rate usually means lower prefill cost.
text.runningAndQueuedRequestsOverTimeARisingQ: Running and queued requests over time. A rising queue means scale out or throttle.
text.prefillCumulativeGenerationRateAndInstan: Prefill, cumulative generation rate, and instant throughput compared.
text.endToEndRequestLatencyPercentilesShowing: End-to-end request latency percentiles, showing full request experience.
text.runningVsQueuedRequestShareALargerQueued: Running vs queued request share. A larger queued slice means higher scheduling pressure.
text.sumOfOutboundTrafficRatesAcrossAllInter4: Sum of outbound traffic rates across all interfaces (bytes/s), from 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets.
text.sumOfInboundTrafficRatesAcrossAllInterf3: Sum of inbound traffic rates across all interfaces (bytes/s), from IF-MIB 64-bit HC counters.
text.sumOfOutboundTrafficRatesAcrossAllInter5: Sum of outbound traffic rates across all interfaces (bytes/s), from IF-MIB 64-bit HC counters.
text.llamaDecodeCallRateOverTheLast5Minutes: llama_decode() call rate over the last 5 minutes.
text.averageBusySlotsPerLlamaDecodeCall: Average busy slots per llama_decode() call.
text.inFlightRequestsIfTheyRiseWithDeferredRe: In-flight requests. If they rise with deferred requests, watch service capacity.
text.deferredRequestsPersistentlyNonZeroMeans: Deferred requests. Persistently non-zero means the service is backing up.
text.kvCacheOccupancyNearFullNewRequestsAreMo: KV cache occupancy. Near full, new requests are more likely to be deferred.
text.inFlightAndDeferredRequestsOverTimeARisi: In-flight and deferred requests over time. A rising deferred series needs attention.
text.promptGenerationCumulativeRateVsAverageT: Prompt/generation cumulative rate vs average throughput.
text.promptVsGenerationAverageThroughputToTel: Prompt vs generation average throughput, to tell whether the two sides are imbalanced.
text.inFlightVsDeferredRequestShareALargerDef: In-flight vs deferred request share. A larger deferred slice means backlog is rising.
text.averageFileReadLatencyPerDatabaseToFindT: Average file read latency per database, to find the slowest readers.
text.averageFileWriteLatencyPerDatabaseToFind: Average file write latency per database, to find the slowest writers.
text.combinedReadWriteOpRatePerDatabaseToFind: Combined read/write op rate per database, to find the heaviest I/O.
text.sqlServerInstanceUptimeSinceLastStart: SQL Server instance uptime since last start.
text.sqlServerDatabaseProcessCPUUsage: SQL Server database process CPU usage.
text.sqlServerInternalMemoryClerkAllocationSi: SQL Server internal memory clerk allocation size.
text.rateAtWhichTheCheckpointProcessFlushesDi: Rate at which the checkpoint process flushes dirty pages to disk.
text.rateAtWhichTheLazyWriterFlushesPagesToFr: Rate at which the lazy writer flushes pages to free buffer pool space.
text.queriesCurrentlyWaitingForAMemoryGrant: Queries currently waiting for a memory grant.
text.requestsThatHaveAQueryWorkspaceMemoryGra: Requests that have a query workspace memory grant but are not finished.
text.averageTimeADataPageStaysInTheBufferPool: Average time a data page stays in the buffer pool.
text.shareOfDataPageReadsServedFromTheBufferP: Share of data-page reads served from the buffer pool.
text.usersCurrentlyConnectedToTheSQLServerIns: Users currently connected to the SQL Server instance.
text.activeWorkerThreadsCurrentlyRunningTasks: Active worker threads currently running tasks on schedulers.
text.sqlServerWaitTimeRateByWaitTypeMsS: SQL Server wait time rate by wait type (ms/s).
text.volumeTotalCapacitySummedAcrossVolumesPe: Volume total capacity (summed across volumes per instance).
text.volumeUsedSpaceSummedAcrossVolumesPerIns: Volume used space (summed across volumes per instance).
text.usedSpaceAcrossInstanceVolumesAsAShareOf: Used space across instance volumes as a share of total capacity.
text.sqlBatchRequestsPerSecondNoFixedThreshol: SQL batch requests per second. No fixed threshold; watch spikes and drops against the business baseline.
text.shareOfDataPageReadsServedFromTheBuffer2: Share of data-page reads served from the buffer pool. A low value means memory or cache pressure is high.
text.averageDatabaseFileReadLatencyASustained: Average database file read latency. A sustained rise needs a storage check; write latency is in the Read/Write Latency trend below.
text.freeSpaceOnTheDatabaseVolumeTooLittleSpa: Free space on the database volume. Too little space affects writes and maintenance.
text.cumulativeWaitTimeRateByWaitTypeMsS: Cumulative wait time rate by wait type (ms/s).
text.rateAtWhichTheCheckpointProcessWritesDir: Rate at which the checkpoint process writes dirty pages to disk; watch with write latency.
text.rateAtWhichTheLazyWriterFreesBufferPoolS: Rate at which the lazy writer frees buffer pool space. A sustained rise with falling page life expectancy means memory pressure.
text.blockedProcessesAndMemoryGrantWaits: Blocked Processes and Memory Grant Waits
text.processesCurrentlyBlockedByLocksOrResour: Processes currently blocked by locks or resource contention.
text.requestsWaitingForQueryWorkspaceMemoryPe: Requests waiting for query workspace memory. Persistently non-zero: check large sorts, hashes, and concurrency.
text.sqlServerConfiguredTargetMemoryALastingG: SQL Server configured target memory. A lasting gap should be checked with memory-grant waits.
text.tempdbCurrentFreeSpaceTooLowAffectsSorts: TempDB current free space. Too low affects sorts, hashes, and temp objects.
text.longTransactionsOrSnapshotReadsPushVersi: Long transactions or snapshot reads push version store growth.
text.transactionLogFlushRateUseWithDatabaseWr: Transaction log flush rate; use with database write latency to judge log I/O pressure.
text.sqlCompilationRateUseWithBatchRequestRat: SQL compilation rate. Use with batch request rate to judge plan-cache efficiency.
text.sqlRecompilationRatePersistentlyHighVsCo: SQL recompilation rate. Persistently high vs compiles adds CPU cost.
text.deadlockRatePersistentlyNonZeroCheckTran: Deadlock rate. Persistently non-zero: check transaction access order and isolation level.
text.usedVsFreeSpaceShareOnTheDatabaseVolume: Used vs free space share on the database volume.
text.currentMixOfActiveWorkersRunnableTasksAn: Current mix of active workers, runnable tasks, and waiting tasks.
text.jvmHeapUsagePerNodeToFindWhereGCPressure: JVM heap usage per node, to find where GC pressure concentrates.
text.elasticsearchProcessCPUUsagePerNodeToFin: Elasticsearch process CPU usage per node, to find where compute load concentrates.
text.dataPathFreeDiskPerNodeMinToFindNodesWit: Data-path free disk per node (min), to find nodes with a tight disk watermark.
text.clusterHealthCode1Green2Yellow3Red: Cluster health code: 1 = green, 2 = yellow, 3 = red.
text.activePrimaryShardsInTheCluster: Active primary shards in the cluster.
text.activePrimaryShardsAsAShareOfPrimaryShar: Active primary shards as a share of primary shards.
text.youngGCTimePerSecondMsSARiseMeansGCIsTak: Young GC time per second (ms/s). A rise means GC is taking more wall-clock time.
text.clusterHealthCode1GreenNormal2YellowUnas: Cluster health code: 1 = green (normal), 2 = yellow (unassigned replicas), 3 = red (missing primaries). If not 1, check unassigned shards and node status.
text.jvmHeapUsagePersistentlyHighValuesIncrea: JVM heap usage. Persistently high values increase GC pressure.
text.elasticsearchProcessCPUUsageHighLoadHurt: Elasticsearch process CPU usage. High load hurts read/write performance.
text.nodeDataPathFreeDiskTooLittleSpaceTrigge: Node data-path free disk. Too little space triggers shard relocation or write protection.
text.shardsNotAllocatedToANodeNonZeroLowersRe: Shards not allocated to a node. Non-zero lowers redundancy/availability. Check offline nodes, disk watermarks, or allocation rules.
text.activePrimaryShardsAsAShareOfPrimariesBe: Active primary shards as a share of primaries. Below 100% means shards are still recovering.
text.writeAndSearchThreadPoolQueueLengths: Write and search thread-pool queue lengths.
text.apacheInstanceUptimeSinceLastStartSecond: Apache instance uptime since last start (seconds).
text.idleApacheWorkersReadyToAcceptRequests: Idle Apache workers ready to accept requests.
text.busyWorkersAsAShareOfTotalWorkersIndicat: Busy workers as a share of total workers, indicating request-handling capacity used.
text.apacheTotalAccessCountChangeRate: Apache total access count change rate.
text.apacheParentConfigReloadCountIncrementsO: Apache parent config reload count; increments on each reload. A spike usually matches a change event or crash restart.
text.instanceUptimeSinceLastStartARestartRes2: Instance uptime since last start; a restart resets the counter.
text.apacheRequestsProcessedPerSecondIndicati: Apache requests processed per second, indicating live throughput.
text.apacheBytesTransferredPerSecondIndicatin: Apache bytes transferred per second, indicating network outbound pressure.
text.busyWorkersAsAShareOfTotalNear100MeansHa: Busy workers as a share of total. Near 100% means handling capacity is nearly exhausted and new requests will queue.
text.apacheTotalAccessesChangePerSecondIndica: Apache total accesses change per second, indicating request-growth trend.
text.byteTransferRateShownSeparatelyFromReque: Byte transfer rate, shown separately from request rate. Traffic spiking while requests stay flat may mean large-file transfers.
text.compareBusyAndIdleWorkersToTellWhetherHa: Compare busy and idle workers to tell whether handling capacity is tight.
text.idleSlotWaitingReadingSendingStatusOverT: Idle-slot / waiting / reading / sending status over time. Sustained rises in sending and reading mean handling pressure is increasing.
text.compare15And15MinuteLoadAveragesToTellWh: Compare 1-, 5-, and 15-minute load averages to tell whether pressure is lasting.
text.systemLoadIncludesAllProcessesNotApacheO: System load includes all processes, not Apache only, so it is not the same as Apache CPU pressure.
text.currentBusyVsIdleWorkerMixTheCenterIsSat: Current busy vs idle worker mix; the center is saturation %.
text.whetherAtLeastOneMatchingProcessIsReport: Whether at least one matching process is reporting metrics.
text.configuredPortLiveness1AllUp0AllDown05Pa: Configured port liveness: 1 = all up, 0 = all down, 0.5 = partially down. No series means ports were not collected.
text.sumOfThreadsInMatchingProcesses: Sum of threads in matching processes.
text.sumOfOpenFDsInMatchingProcessesHigherPri: Sum of open FDs in matching processes. Higher privileges may be required to collect this.
text.aliveWhenAtLeastOneMatchingProcessIsRepo: Alive when at least one matching process is reporting procstat metrics. No data means the process was not collected in this window.
text.shownOnlyWhenCollectionConfiguredPortsAl: Shown only when collection configured ports. All up / partially down / all down. Hidden when ports are not configured.
text.sumOfMatchingProcessCPUUsageIfPersistent: Sum of matching-process CPU usage. If persistently high, compare thread count and host CPU to tell a single process pegged from host-wide contention.
text.sumOfProcessMemoryAsAShareOfSystemMemory: Sum of process memory as a share of system memory. Compare with the RSS trend below for absolute use vs relative pressure.
text.sumOfMatchingProcessThreadsAnUnusualSpik: Sum of matching-process threads. An unusual spike may come with CPU contention or a thread leak.
text.compareProcessCPUUsageAndAppMemoryUsageO: Compare process CPU usage and app memory usage over time.
text.sumOfProcessRSSASustainedRiseNeedsALeakO: Sum of process RSS. A sustained rise needs a leak or cache-growth check.
text.sumOfOpenFileDescriptorsPersistentlyNear: Sum of open file descriptors. Persistently near ulimit: check for leaks first. If there is no data, check collection privileges.
text.frontendCurrentActiveSessionsSummedByFro: FRONTEND current active sessions (summed by frontend proxy).
text.backendRequestsCurrentlyQueuedForAServer: BACKEND requests currently queued for a server.
text.rateOfRequestsRedispatchedToAnotherBacke: Rate of requests redispatched to another backend server.
text.frontendHTTPRequestRateMeasuringIngressL: FRONTEND HTTP request rate, measuring ingress load.
text.backendAverageResponseTimeWhenItRisesSpl: BACKEND average response time. When it rises, split the bottleneck with queue time and connect time.
text.activeServersInBACKENDPoolsDedupedByProx: Active servers in BACKEND pools (deduped by proxy, then summed). On a drop, check health-check failures and UP→DOWN transitions.
text.backendLatencyBreakdownQueueQtimeConnect: BACKEND latency breakdown: queue (qtime), connect (ctime), response (rtime), end-to-end (ttime).
text.backendResponseStatusCodeRatesWatch5xxRi: BACKEND response status-code rates. Watch 5xx rises.
text.checkFailDownConnErrorRetry: Check Fail / Down / Conn Error / Retry
text.healthCheckFailuresUPDOWNTransitionsConn: Health-check failures, UP→DOWN transitions, connect/response errors, and retries/redispatches.
text.frontendInboundAndOutboundByteRates: FRONTEND inbound and outbound byte rates.
text.overallMemoryUsagePersistentlyHighValue3: Overall memory usage. Persistently high values can hurt forwarding and routing performance.
text.highestReadingAmongChassisSensorsUnusua2: Highest reading among chassis sensors. Unusual rises may be fan failure or poor cooling. Models without hardware sensors show "--".
text.compareCPUAndMemoryUsageBothHighForLong4: Compare CPU and memory usage. Both high for long means the router is under pressure.
text.chassisMaxTemperatureOverTimeCASustaine2: Chassis max temperature over time (°C). A sustained rise needs a fan/cooling check. Models without hardware sensors show empty.
text.fanStatusOverTime1IsNormalALineOff12Abn2: Fan status over time; 1 is normal. A line off 1 (2 = abnormal) means a cooling fault. Models without a fan-status OID show empty.
text.psuStatusOverTime1IsNormalALineOff1Mean3: PSU status over time; 1 is normal. A line off 1 means lost PSU redundancy or hardware fault. Models without a PSU-status OID show empty.
text.showsWhetherThisInstanceSMonitoringColle: Shows whether this instance's monitoring collection is healthy, missing, or abnormal in the selected window.
text.noDetailsToShowInTheCurrentTimeRange: No details to show in the current time range
